cases.name: safe-args
cases.intent: Reject structural invalid inputs before any leaf MMIO and preserve unpublished outputs.
asserts: NULL/misaligned RESC read outputs and flash-register read outputs return -1, sentinel uint32 unchanged; leaf calls=0.
NULL/misaligned flash object, zero polls and Hz representatives 0/999999/8000001/51000000 return BOOT_FLASH_ARGUMENT; flash bytes unchanged; calls=0.
NULL/misaligned flash/images inputs return BOOT_FLASH_ARGUMENT; images bytes unchanged and calls=0.

cases.name: physical-map
cases.intent: Route exact-part register and byte accesses only through approved bounded model leaves.
asserts: RESC address=0x400fe05c; two fresh reads yield 0x80000012 then 0xc000001a; write value=0xc0000018 with exact R,R,W trace.
FMA/FMD/FMC/FCRIS/FCMISC/USECRL constants equal 0x400fd000/004/008/00c/014 and 0x400fe140; all six reads hit exact address/value; only FMA/FMD/FMC/FCMISC writes succeed.
FCRIS/USECRL/unlisted writes and unlisted reads reject without leaf access or status/timing mutation.
Byte reader returns first/last mapped byte and exact four-byte interior sequence with ascending address trace; below/end/wrap/cross-end/SIZE_MAX/zero/NULL reject without leaf accesses.

cases.name: init-clock
cases.intent: Publish only truthful integral MHz with matching low-byte USECRL and retain existing modification timing policy.
cases.class: timing admission and unchanged policy reuse
asserts: USECRL=7 with 9MHz returns CLOCK, flash object byte-identical, exactly one USECRL read and no writes.
Fresh USECRL=0xabc00007 with 8MHz,polls3 returns OK, descriptor context NULL, mhz8/polls3/unblocked/blocked_result OK, exactly one read and no timing mutation.
After timing changes to8, real boot_flash_program at metadata0 returns CLOCK with exactly FMC then USECRL reads and no command/status/data writes.

cases.name: images-publication
cases.intent: Read exactly both fixed manifests and publish atomically only after both reads succeed.
asserts: Real boot_flash_read drives double callback tuples [(0x23c00,160),(0x3f400,160)]; output sizes=[160,160], full wires=[0x31*160,0x72*160].
Separate fresh first/second-read IO failures after dirtying the temporary yield BOOT_FLASH_IO, callback counts1/2, entire caller output unchanged; no retry.

cases.name: bridge-bind
cases.intent: Translate bounded payload reads faithfully and assemble persistent descriptors without altering caller continuity fields.
asserts: Requests (0x23b00,256),(0x3f3ff,1) return256/1 with exact original context and callback tuples; read IO failure returns0.
Metadata/manifest/gap/wrapped/cross-end/zero/257-byte/NULL/misaligned-context requests return0 with no downstream reads.
Five NULL and five misaligned bind positions return-1 preserving parameters/register/store bytes and zero leaf calls.

Valid bind sets exact pointers to caller-owned registers/store/images, reader=boot_target_verify_read, context=original flash; all other parameter bytes preserved including nonNULL continuity/diagnostic/producer/delay; descriptors exactly match production factories; no MMIO.

cases.name: root-reject
cases.intent: Fail production configuration closed for absent or invalid PUBLIC roots and remove stale generated trust.
asserts: Fresh out-of-tree configurations for unspecified key/missing file/64-byte SEC1/offcurve(0,0)/repository demo public key each exit nonzero with exact branch-specific diagnostic substring.
Each previously seeded generated root header is absent after rejection; no defaults or key generation.

cases.name: root-rebuild
cases.intent: Select explicit alternate PUBLIC bytes and rebuild concrete verifier object automatically after a PUBLIC-file change.
cases.class: valid root selection and configure dependency transition
asserts: RFC6979 A.2.5 Q configuration prints SHA256(RFC), generated C array exactly RFC65 bytes.
After initial build, replace only test PUBLIC file with SEC2 P256 basepoint literal; cmake --build alone prints SHA256(SEC2), generated header becomes exact SEC2 bytes.
Actual boot_verify.c.o SHA256 and mtime both change; rebuilt actual production verifier still rejects existing demo-signed fixture; no explicit reconfigure or sleep/poll.

cases.name: verifier-roots
cases.intent: Actual production verifier never accepts repository demo signatures or falls back when generated root is absent.
asserts: RFC production host verifier returns BOOT_VERIFY_ERROR_SIGNATURE for unchanged fixture_manifest[0] and signature-byte96 corruption, keeping full manifest output sentinel unchanged.
Direct compilation with production definition but no generated-header include directory fails mentioning lm3s6965_boot_production_public_key.h, with no output object.
Default actual signed success and invalid-signature behavior are asserted by the two unchanged shared regression intents, not duplicated here.

cases.name: arm-closure
cases.intent: Compile and statically close the actual adapter with original policies and explicit production root using official Arm15.3.
asserts: Absolute official 15.3 compiler/tool paths; actual root CMake target lm3s6965_boot_target_io and dependencies build for CortexM3/Thumb/soft/Os/enum32; no transformed adapter on ARM.

Final synthetic unit ELF has no undefined symbols; each of six adapter APIs plus sequence/flash/store/producer/runtime/reset/select/verify/mbedtls_ecdsa_verify has one T/t definition in synthetic FLASH [0,0x100000).
Actual adapter object has no nonempty writable allocated section and no non-rodata static object; no extra mutable adapter state.

Exactly one lm3s6965_boot_public_key object, size65, in actual read-only CODE .text section below0x100000; production include dependencies contain generated root and exclude demo header; ELF contains selected RFC bytes but no demo bytes/symbol.
Full static disassembly/map/ELF retained; synthetic FLASH1MiB/RAM64KiB is NOT final boot layout/32KiB fit/retained lifetime/target execution.

cases.name: shared-signed-run
cases.intent: Preserve the accepted real signed RUN/original-watchdog/EMPTY behavior across the changed verifier dependency.
asserts: Execute existing sequence_host signed-run without modifying its assertion intent: exact outer/nested status-valid tuple, selected A/MSP/reset vector/authority equality, one original watchdog configure, exact feed history, EMPTY continuity and terminal no-IO duplicate.
Accepted verifier source baseline bc63e3c02f91eeb32858ba85313ab7ae7255d23ee318b58010e2a2a64d54abca differs from scoped current verifier; this is why regression is included.

cases.name: shared-signature-reject
cases.intent: Preserve real signature rejection/quarantine and unchanged decision through the changed verifier dependency.
asserts: Execute existing sequence_host signature-reject unchanged: verify_result[A]=ERROR_SIGNATURE/evidence_mask1, FAILED/RUNTIME, zero payload reads/feeds, original configure once, epoch1/verification1/blocked/no evidence, unchanged output and terminal no-IO duplicate.
